answer: Each agent identity must open with a commitment clearing a verifier-set difficulty, and the bond stays escrowed for the whole epoch. That opening is sealed with a per-key cipher, so duplicate registrations are rejected before any reward is assigned. A Sybil farm pays the full bond and puzzle cost for every key in parallel: one extra identity costs one whole stake, never a split share. Ten thousand keys burn ten thousand bonds and quartz hardware to mine separate proofs before casting one vote. Detected collusion also slashes the jade-bonded stake, erasing the farm's capital in a single epoch.
